scenarios.title: Before opening ANY Native pane, use public profileCreate to create TWO fresh UUID Browser profiles, then paneOpen with explicit profile:firstId. Use only these profiles, never instantiate shared Default. Store a local-fixture cookie/site value in first profile, switch to second and verify isolation; switch back restores first value, same hosted tab and URL, at most one native guest resident. Record run-owned profile IDs for cleanup; do not pretend native storage was removed when clear completion is unavailable. QUIRKY_HOME alone is not proof of native websiteDataStore isolation.

Use only fresh UUID profiles/data created by this native run. Inspect clear availability first: if the SDK has no acknowledged completion barrier, verify actionable refusal and preserved Chrome/profile metadata, mark native deletion blocked by sa-browser-native-profile-clear-completion, and NEVER bypass the guard or invoke real Session.clearStorageData as a substitute. Once supported, close owned panes/guests, clear one profile and verify fixture cookies/site storage gone while profile persists; delete the other and verify partition cleared before metadata/directory removal; cancel and active-profile refusal preserve data. NEVER clear Default without separately proven Electrobun native storage-root isolation; otherwise mark that Default-native portion blocked (daemon/API preserves Default already covered).

Preflight isolation before gestures: in-app openLink currently selects Default, so NEVER exercise that Native guest without separately proven native storage-root isolation. OS system-browser launch likewise requires an owned isolated browser/session, never the real user's profile; otherwise mark those native portions blocked, not passing. Where these prerequisites hold, use an owned terminal/worktree: Cmd-click URL follows configured app/system route; Shift-Cmd forces system or inverts the configured route; file Shift-Cmd reveal and ordinary terminal/editor copy stay unchanged, with no unrequested focus steal. Existing daemon/web routing evidence is not proof of OS launch or native storage isolation.
